name: Phial of Scrying
summary: Across Darkshore, scouts reach Onu from perilous ground. Onu provides the Phial of Scrying, whose enchanted waters form a bowl for divination across the corrupted woodlands.

sections.title: A Lens Across Darkshore
sections.body: Scouts deep in Darkshore use the Phial of Scrying for long-distance divination. Its mystical waters form a temporary bowl on the ground. From perilous places such as the Master's Glaive, they can speak with Onu without returning to his grove.

sections.title: Uncovering the Cult
sections.body: Onu gives scouts the phial to watch the Twilight's Hammer cultists. At the place where an ancient fallen master lies impaled by an enormous glaive, a scout opens a scrying link. The vision confirms that dark cultists gather around the ancient remains, seeking slivers of forgotten power that linger even in death.

faq.q: What does the Phial of Scrying do?
faq.answer: Uncork the Phial of Scrying and a magical bowl forms on the ground. From the field, you can use it to contact Onu and speak with him across vast distances.

faq.q: Who provides the Phial of Scrying?
aliases: where do i get the phial
faq.answer: The ancient treant Onu gives the phial to scouts in Darkshore when he sends them south to reconnoiter the Master's Glaive.

faq.q: What happens if the phial is lost or exhausted?
faq.answer: If you lose the phial or use it before finishing your mission, Onu can give you another while he meditates in Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is Onu scrying into the Master's Glaive?
faq.answer: Onu knows an old lord fell at the Master's Glaive, and asks you to search there for Twilight's Hammer cultists. Their purpose becomes clear as the investigation continues.

angles.text: As a night elf of Darkshore, you know scrying waters help keep watch over holy woodlands encroached upon by alien cults.
As a druid, you recognize scrying bowls as a blend of natural water and communion magic. They let the forest's wardens exchange whispers across corrupted ground.
